events.title: Patch Notes (10/10)
events.summary: Patch Notes:Adjusted dash movement based on player feedback.Added the global top 50 leaderboard! You can now see your own rank and the top 50 players worldwide.Fixed various bugs and made some general improvements and optimizations.
